reviews.reviewbody: A big dissapointment after Tape 4 (lol, like LBJ is a performer). Anyways, in this tape, he talks about appointments in South America, U.K. troubles, heck he even makes peace with Mr. Yarborough. But it's still pretty bland. It picks up somewhat when there's a bit of a racial conflict in a school in Shorter Alabama, but even then it sounds muted. Really a bit of a snoozer.
